name: Tanamachi Kaoru
source:
One of the protagonist's childhood friends and class 2-A classmate, she is often seen with his other friend Masayoshi. She is unpredictable as she would punch the protagonist anytime. She works part-time at a family restaurant to support her single mother, who later dates another man.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amagami]AniDB[/url]]
